ADMIN.TITLE: Admin Panel
ADMIN.SUBTITLE: Platform stats, users, and live-editable settings.
ADMIN.SETTINGS_HINT: Overrides here take effect immediately on the pricing page. They don't change enforcement limits until the corresponding env var is also updated.
ADMIN.FEATURES_HINT: These toggles are fully enforced on the backend immediately — not just display settings. Disabling payments makes every plan-gated feature free for every user right now; disabling referrals stops new referral codes from being applied.
ADMIN.PAYMENTS_TOGGLE_DESC: When off, checkout and the billing portal are disabled, and every user is treated as top-tier for all plan limits — the whole product becomes free.
ADMIN.PAYMENTS_OFF_WARNING: Payments are OFF — the app is currently free for everyone.
ADMIN.REFERRALS_TOGGLE_DESC: When off, new signups can't apply a referral code and the referral page is hidden. Past reward history is untouched.
ADMIN.COUPONS_HINT: Real Stripe coupons — customers can enter the code directly at checkout. Coupons can't be deleted once used, only deactivated.
